title: Minimum native Gaussian rank for a partial Pauli contract
body:
This enabling proof gives the exact minimum native Gaussian rank over all symplectic completions of any compatible partial signed Pauli map. A dimension-uniform constructive Lagrangian argument attains the formula; a Pauli correction fixes all compatible signs without changing the rank. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cc0f40e71133a9ddb922bf39c93785c1a43017b9/research/partial-pauli-gaussian-minimum/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cc0f40e71133a9ddb922bf39c93785c1a43017b9/research/partial-pauli-gaussian-minimum/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cc0f40e71133a9ddb922bf39c93785c1a43017b9/research/partial-pauli-gaussian-minimum/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cc0f40e71133a9ddb922bf39c93785c1a43017b9/research/partial-pauli-gaussian-minimum/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 10,113 complete extension fibers, 386 signed lifts, 848 literal matrix-column identities and five controls. Both print `PASS_PARTIAL_PAULI_GAUSSIAN_MINIMUM`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/partial-pauli-gaussian-minimum
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted planning and the registered package replay passed on this exact head in [run 39998914288](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39998914288). No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Implement the quotient construction on one actual contact constraint set, retain its literal phase and charge all monomial passes. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit @JoyboyBrian's [PR #5051](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5051) supplies the signed partial-map contract, compatibility test, fixed-prefix extension and turn convention in [pauli.py](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0960807a68ff46acbe6510c8867912ef2324ee71/research/signed-pauli-partial-extension/pauli.py). @Dugongue's [PR #4841](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4841) supplies the native Gaussian rank, monomial-factor bill and absolute-phase contract in the [compiler proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6debdcdac8fe1c87958f8cd42ccb7db73c0a0eef/research/native-clifford-gauge-compiler/compiler/CLIFFORD-COMPILER.md). @petalas's partial-transvection work is a separate tariff predecessor, as recorded in the released handoff. Symplectic basis extension and the Clifford/Bruhat methods are classical; this result addresses minimization over the prescribed extension fiber. The checker adapts the credited source's literal turn conventions and extension steps, and independently enumerates the full small completion fibers.

Prepared by @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
